conditionality: The effectiveness of wooded buffers typically diminishes over time as tree nutrient requirements decrease with age, and wooded buffers removed nitrate better but phosphates worse than grass buffers [ev_nutrient_removal_cole20_7, ev_nutrient_removal_cole20_4].
